class.name: TTSPersonaSettings
class.description: An entry of [TTSPersonaListSettings]: the values of a [TTSPersona] that the player created or changed, and whether it is the player's default persona. In a CSV file it is one row. [TTSPersonaSettingsServer] applies it to [TTSServer] as a persona override (see [method TTSServer.set_persona_override]); [method to_persona] creates that [TTSPersona]. The value ranges are the same as those of [TTSPersona].

method.name: copy_from_persona
method.description: Takes all values of [param persona]. [member default] is not changed.

method.name: to_persona
method.description: Returns a new [TTSPersona] with the values of this entry. Changing it does not change the entry.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this persona is the player's default persona (see [method TTSServer.set_default_persona_override]). At most one entry should have it set; [method TTSPersonaSettingsServer.set_default_persona] keeps it that way. If a hand-edited file marks several entries, the first one is used.
The name of the persona, the key of the entry. If the game has a persona with this name, this entry replaces it for the player.
See [member TTSPersona.voice]. A voice that does not exist on the current device is kept; [method TTSServer.resolve_voice_id] picks another voice then.
